eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: My Past? Sorry, I'm afraid I can't remember much... When I first open my eyes, the only thing I recalled was a dimly lit room

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: I thought there were only bad humans.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: But I guess if your Mayor said so, then you're okay.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: After I awake, I found myself in the Dark Place, I ran as far as I could and before I know it I found myself here...

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: I drink from the pool every day.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: Soldiers pass through here a couple times a year.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: We always hide when they do.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: I can see the whole town from up high.
